name: Four-cell low-voltage backup design study
audience: Engineering students and early design engineers comparing connection arrangements
decision: Compare same-end output collection, opposite-end negative collection and a physically specified lower-resistance conductor/contact alternative.

preparation.classification: declared initial state, not a measured initializer

threshold_source: Declared prototype comparison target; replace with an actual device specification before claiming device compatibility.
priorities: Review conductor length, mass, resistance, space and cooling assumptions
component_policy: Use cell-specific direction and temperature limits, independently of user design targets.
model_policy: Choose the cell family after assessment. Use the same cell model and preparation for physical alternatives. Do not treat published tables or assumed thermal properties as independent module validation.
thermal_policy: Compare a declared lumped surface-equivalent heat model. Missing custom data may use the versioned example cylindrical preset. Measured thermal acceptance and a hardware safety rating require appropriate independent evidence.
release_state: Benchmark specified and application records implemented; final cell-family selection and three-option evidence remain open.
